programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous regardons le phoque gris.

programme.title: Mammiferes Marins FR: La societé dauphins
programme.desc: In this episode we look at the dolphin society.

programme.title: L'arche de Norin
programme.desc:
Norin reçoit un appel d'Afrique du Sud. Des animaux sauvages sont blessés ou atteints de maladies mystérieuses.
Pour résoudre ces cas, Norin doit inventer de nouvelles techniques opératoires.

programme.title: L'arche de Norin
programme.desc: Alors qu'il ausculte un hibou grand-duc, le directeur du centre reçoit un appel de détresse signalant une hyène qui s'est prise le cou dans un piège. Norin et son équipe sautent dans une voiture pour se rendre sur les lieux.

programme.title: Orphelins de la nature: Un déménagement périlleux
programme.desc: Trois lions adultes de Nankusee sont en danger car des braconniers les ont repérés et pourraient les empoisonner ; il faut donc déplacer ces fauves, un exercice dangereux.

programme.title: Orphelins de la nature: Les léopards quittent le nid
programme.desc: Les bébés léopards Umbili et Shakira deviennent une réelle menace pour la sécurité de Zacheo et doivent être déplacés. Sur une note plus comique, les bébés babouins intègrent définitivement la bande des adultes.

programme.title: Sabrina, Apprentie sorcière: Le concours radio
programme.desc: Hilda et Zelda veulent une voiture, et ont besoin d'argent rapidement ! Quigley leur explique qu'elles doivent trouver un bon vieux travail.

programme.title: Sabrina, Apprentie sorcière: Les trois fantômes de Noël
programme.desc: C'est la période de Noël et les pitreries égoïstes de Gem rendent tout le monde fou ! Sabrina et sa famille complotent pour lui montrer son erreur en lui rendant une visite du type Noël Carole.

programme.title: Sabrina, Apprentie sorcière: Une heure au soleil
programme.desc: Sabrina en a marre du temps hivernal. Elle, Chloé et Salem donneraient tout pour une heure à la plage. Sabrina trempe dans le bocal de Spookie et c'est parti.

programme.title: Sabrina, Apprentie sorcière: La clé de mon coeur
programme.desc: Sabrina a le béguin pour Dave, son nouveau professeur de piano. Elle est dévastée lorsqu'elle apprend qu'il a déjà une femme dans sa vie, Melinda.

programme.title: Sabrina, Apprentie sorcière: La femme espion
programme.desc: Harvey est très impatient d'acheter la cassette vidéo du dernier film d'espionnage de son héros préféré, mais la sortie est repoussée et Harvey est déçu...

programme.title: Sabrina, Apprentie sorcière: Le gang des vampires
programme.desc: Trois chanteurs crooners vampires arrivent à Greendale. Ils sont à la recherche de tante Hilda.

programme.title: Sabrina, Apprentie sorcière: Une dure vie de sorcière
programme.desc: Sabrina rêve de vivre dans le luxe et sans personne pour continuellement contrôler ses faits et gestes.

programme.title: Sabrina, Apprentie sorcière: La disparition d'oncle Quigley
programme.desc: Oncle Quigley, lassé de ne pas être assez apprécié, quitte la maison et laisse à sa place une gouvernante très méchante.

programme.title: Sabrina, Apprentie sorcière: Il était une loi...
programme.desc: Sabrina fait apparaître accidentellement une princesse de conte de fées.

programme.title: Sabrina, Apprentie sorcière: En toute malice
programme.desc: Sabrina rêve de faire partie de l'équipe des pom-pom girls de l'école, elle est en compétition avec Emilie.

programme.title: Il était une fois le Pérou
programme.desc: 4 000 ans avant la civilisation Inca et l'arrivée des Conquistadores, les Andes et la côte nord du Pérou ont été le berceau des premières civilisations du pays. Nous découvrons ici le quotidien et les coutumes de différentes sociétés précolombiennes.

programme.title: Nazi Hunters: Erich Priebke
programme.desc: Erich Priebke, l'un des plus hauts gradés de la Gestapo à Rome pendant la guerre, est responsable de l'une des pires atrocités commises en Italie.

programme.title: Nazi Hunters: Joseph Mengele
programme.desc: Le Dr Joseph Mengele, sans doute le plus célèbre des fugitifs nazis, a été surnommé "l'ange de la mort" pour ses expériences perverses et sadiques à Auschwitz-Birkenau.

programme.title: Nazi Hunters: Kurt Lischka
programme.desc: En tant que chef de la Gestapo à Paris, Kurt Lischka ordonne la plus grande arrestation de masse de l'histoire de France et est responsable du meurtre de 33 000 Juifs.

programme.title: Secrets de Musées: Le Musée historique d'Etat de Moscou
programme.desc: Le Musée historique d'Etat de Moscou présente l'histoire de la Russie et de son peuple sur une période s'étendant de l'âge de pierre à la chute du Mur de Berlin.

programme.title: Secrets de Musées: Le Kunsthistorisches Museum de Vienne
programme.desc: Le Musée de l'histoire de l'art de Vienne regorge d'antiquités et d'oeuvres accumulées par la dynastie des Habsbourg, qui a dominé une grande partie de l'Europe pendant cinq siècles.

programme.title: Chacun son Île
programme.desc: Même si l’archipel de San Andrés y Providencia se trouve à moins de 200 km du Nicaragua, il appartient à la Colombie, qui est située à quelque 770 km au sud.

programme.title: Chacun son Île
programme.desc: L’île de Phú Quốc est située dans le golfe de Thaïlande, à l’ouest de l’hameçon vietnamien et en face de la côte cambodgienne.

programme.title: Habiter le monde: Cuba: La Havane, ville-potager
programme.desc: Au milieu de la Havane, capitale de Cuba, se trouvent des « organoponicos », ou jardins-potagers. Philippe part à la découverte de cette alliance unique entre ville et agriculture pour comprendre comment elle a transformé le quotidien des Havanais.

programme.title: Habiter le monde: SVALBARD Ny-Ålesund: un village scientifique
programme.desc: Dans l’archipel de Svalbard, près du cercle polaire, se trouve le village le plus septentrional du monde : Ny Alesund. Philippe découvre ce lieu du bout du monde mais qui, loin d’en être coupé, se révèle être un miroir des changements climatiques.

programme.title: Habiter le monde: Suède: Malmö, la renaissance verte
programme.desc: Malmö est la troisième ville de Suède. Sa spécificité : elle n’a pas seulement misé sur les technologies mais aussi, et surtout, sur l’implication des habitants. Philippe découvre la façon dont les habitants se sont réappropriés leur ville.

programme.title: Chacun son Île
programme.desc: On dit que l’île de Marajó est la deuxième île fluviale la plus grande du monde.

programme.title: Aujourd'hui Madame

programme.title: Wicked Tuna

programme.title: Wicked Tuna
programme.desc: Les pêcheurs de Gloucester, dans le Massachusetts, doivent affronter des hordes de pêcheurs amateurs maladroits alors qu'ils pourchassent le lucratif thon rouge de l'Atlantique.

programme.title: Wicked Tuna
programme.desc: Une tempête se dirige vers les zones de pêche de l'Atlantique Nord, mais comme la saison touche à sa fin, les capitaines n'ont d'autre choix que d'aller pêcher par mauvais temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 2
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Shredder met sa menace à exécution et fait exploser le collier de mutagène de Baxter Stockman, toujours incapable de lui fournir une armée de mutants digne de ce nom. Stockman mute en mouche et devient Stockman la mouche.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende du Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Steranko, un obscur marchand d'armes borgne, est à la recherche d'un objet qui viendra compléter sa collection d'armures. Il s'agit du « Kuro Kabuto », le casque de Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Plan 10
programme.desc: Les Krangs testent une nouvelle machine pour envahir la Terre, qui consiste à permuter les cerveaux. Ils pourront ainsi manœuvrer les leaders terriens et parvenir à leurs fins.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage dans la Dimension X
programme.desc: En voulant trouver une source d'énergie pour sa Tortue Mécha, Donnie ouvre un portail vers la dimension X. Il capte alors un message de Leatherhead, qui est prisonnier des Krangs. Celui-ci l'informe que les Krangs ont perfectionné le mutagène.

programme.title: iCarly: En couple avec Sam et Freddie
programme.desc: Sam et Freddie sortent ensemble pour la plus grande joie de Carly qui est ravie de voir ses deux amis amoureux après s'être détestés toutes ces années.

programme.title: iCarly: Insupportable!
programme.desc: La relation entre Sam et Freddie commence à peser sur tout le monde ! Gibby devient le souffre-douleur attitré de Sam, Carly se fait évincer de la caméra, et aussi des sorties avec ses amies.

programme.title: iCarly: Je t'aime
programme.desc: Carly suggère à Freddie et Sam de passer plus de temps ensemble et d'apprendre à se connaître. Sam ira donc jouer au petit train avec Freddie et ses copains et Freddie accompagnera Sam visiter son oncle et son cousin en prison. Mais c'est un échec.

programme.title: iCarly: L'intello
programme.desc: Carly rencontre Kyle, un garçon très intelligent. Pour ne pas paraître stupide à ses yeux, elle étudie et fait des recherches sur Internet avant leur rendez-vous.

programme.title: iCarly: rencontre la Première Dame des États-Unis
programme.desc: Carly se réjouit de revoir son père qui rentre fêter son anniversaire avec elle et Spencer. Malheureusement, la jeune fille déchante très vite quand elle apprend que son père ne pourra finalement pas rentrer.

programme.title: iCarly: Nora, à la folie Pt1
programme.desc: Incarcérée pour avoir kidnappé et torturé la bande d'iCarly, Nora Dershlit est sur le point d'obtenir une libération conditionnelle.

programme.title: iCarly: Nora, à la folie Pt2
programme.desc: Incarcérée pour avoir kidnappé et torturé la bande d'iCarly, Nora Dershlit est sur le point d'obtenir une libération conditionnelle.

programme.title: iCarly: Grosses galères et gâteaux gras
programme.desc: Sam n'a pas fait de bêtise depuis 10 jours. En récompense, ses amis lui offrent une visite guidée d'une fabrique de gâteaux gras canadiens, ses pâtisseries préférées.

programme.title: iCarly: Plein les yeux
programme.desc: Freddie est frustré de n'être qu'un technicien. Il rêve de participer à l'aspect artistique de l'émission. Carly devant s'absenter pour le week-end, Sam accepte à contrecoeur de le laisser présenter iCarly avec elle.

programme.title: iCarly: Christopher Cane présente
programme.desc: Christopher Cane (l'acteur anglais qui joue le rôle de Rex dans Victorious) reçoit l'équipe d'iCarly dans son émission.

programme.title: iCarly: L'épidémie One Direction
programme.desc: Carly attrape une maladie contagieuse et contamine un membre des One Direction accidentellement.

programme.title: Good Burger

programme.title: Head of State

programme.title: Double Team

programme.title: The Killer Meteors
programme.desc: Mei Xing He is a local hero, as known as 'Killer Meteors', his secret weapon makes him invincible. However, when Hua Wu Bin, another powerful local character seeks his assistance, Mei Xing He will face the deadliest challenge of his life.

programme.title: Shaolin Wooden Men [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his father, Little Mute trains in Shaolin Temple for revenge and is taught by various teachers, one of which is clandestine.

programme.title: The Big Lebowski
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges, John Goodman, Steve Buscemi and Julianne Moore star in this Coen brothers’ cult comedy about the Dude, his buddies, a case of mistaken identity, kidnapping and bowling.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians threatens to move the team unless the team delivers immediate results. She then fills the roster with has-beens to guarantee their failure. But the team miraculously rallies and starts winning.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Ex
programme.desc: After getting fired, a man winds up working for his wife's father while she takes care of the baby.

programme.title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
programme.desc: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah takes her eccentric grandma's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of paid rent.

programme.title: What's Love Got to Do With It?
programme.desc: In London, an award-winning filmmaker documents her best friend's journey into an arranged marriage in line with his family's Pakistani heritage. In the process, she challenges her own attitude towards relationships.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Varsity Blues
programme.desc: At first, backup quarterback Jonathan is no football star. But when the starting quarterback is injured, he is thrown into the game and also finds himself in direct conflict with his coach and girlfriend.

programme.title: Paint Your Wagon
programme.desc: A Michigan farmer and a prospector form a partnership in the California gold country. Their adventures include buying and sharing a wife...

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Juwanna Mann
programme.desc: A basketball star is booted out of the NBA when his on-court antics go too far, so he poses as a woman and joins the WUBA. Rated PG-13

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Britt Reid is a slacker by day, party animal by night... until he finds a serious career that's seriously cool: crime-fighting action hero. As the Green Hornet, he teams up with gadget wiz and martial arts master Kato to take down LA's underworld.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair faces an even greater threat lurking beneath the surface.

programme.title: Married to the Mob
programme.desc: A mobster's wife hates her lifestyle, but gets a chance to change it when her husband is killed--if the Long Island mob and the FBI let her.

programme.title: The Pope Of Greenwich Village
programme.desc: Daryl Hannah, Mickey Rourke and Eric Roberts star in this funny, high-voltage story of two small-time thieves after a big score in New York's Little Italy.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: When Jack Deebs was behind bars he found escape by creating Cool World, a cartoon series featuring a vixen named Holli Would. The flesh proves weaker than ink, however, as Holli takes human form in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: Urban Legends: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: On a prom night dare, a trio of high school friends chants an incantation, unleashing an evil spirit from the past with deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Possession of Hannah Grace
programme.desc: Following a failed exorcism, Megan Reed (Shay Mitchell) is working overnight at the morgue when she takes delivery of a disfigured cadaver. Soon, Megan begins to experience horrifying visions and starts to suspect that a demon may possess her body.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. "This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: 1930's New York. The black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. If the seeds of Harlem's urban power would not grow in the White city, the Black underground would form to take control.

programme.title: Road to Perdition
programme.desc: Bonds of loyalty are put to the test when a hitman's son witnesses what his father does for a living.

programme.title: Prey (2007)
programme.desc: While on holiday, an Amerian family are trapped by hungry lions in South Africa.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying novel by Stephen King... After the Creed family moves to rural Maine, they stumble upon an ancient burial ground with sinister powers. When tragedy strikes, a perilous chain of events unleashes an unfathomable evil.

programme.title: The Black Cat
programme.desc: When the townspeople of a small village begin to die in a series of horrible accidents, an inspector arrives to investigate. But when suspicion falls on a local medium who records conversations with the dead, the grisly deaths take on a sinister twist.

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: The legendary indie film that launched the career of Kevin Smith and won over audiences with its raw energy, outrageous comedy, and a hip soundtrack. CLERKS features razor-sharp wit and the debut of pop-culture icons Jay and Silent Bob.

programme.title: Mallrats
programme.desc: Two loafers who spend way too much time at the mall try to win back their girlfriends with the help of the ultimate delinquents, Silent Bob and Jay.

programme.title: Chasing Amy
programme.desc: Cult comic-book artist Holden falls head-over-heels with fellow artist Alyssa, but, for that love to live, he'll need to contend with his disapproving best friend Banky, her sexuality, and his own misgivings about himself in this Kevin Smith classic.

programme.title: The Friends of Eddie Coyle
programme.desc: As a small time hood Eddie is about to go back to jail. In order to escape this fate he deals information on stolen guns to the feds. Simultaneously he is supplying arms to his bank robbing/kidnapping hoodlum chums.

programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: James Caan and Robert Duvall star in Sam Peckinpah's tense, action-packed thriller that explores savagery and betrayal in the murky world of killers-for-hire.

programme.title: Chinatown
programme.desc: Jake Gittes, a private eye, uncovers a web of personal and political scandals while he is hired by a beautiful socialite to investigate her husband's extra marital affair.

programme.title: The Crow: Salvation
programme.desc: Alex Corvis returns to the world of the living to solve the murder of a young woman that he was wrongly accused of.

programme.title: The Crow: Wicked Prayer
programme.desc: The fourth film in the dark superhero franchise is an epic new action tale. After an ex-con tries to straighten out his life, he and his girlfriend are brutally murdered by a renegade gang. A mysterious crow brings him back for revenge and redemption.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: The Return
programme.desc: The "Universal Soldiers" must fight the entire army when the military's supercomputer, S.E.T.H., gets out of control.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: As a couple welcomes a newborn baby into their home, a demonic presence begins terrorizing them, tearing apart their perfect world and turning it into an inescapable nightmare.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3
programme.desc: Paranormal Activity 3 takes you back to where it all began, and the activity is more intense than ever. The cameras are on and recording the chilling moments when evil begins to terrorize young sisters Katie and Kristi for the first time.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 4
programme.desc: Katie disappeared with her nephew, Hunter, and there were no survivors. Five years later, she's returned with a mysterious boy, ready to target new victims with her demonic rage in a quiet neighborhood.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: As rioting and civil unrest rocks Detroit during the summer of 1967, several policemen begin interrogating guests at the Algiers Motel; by the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.

programme.title: The Impossible
programme.desc: A couple and their three sons encounter terror, courage and compassion following the December 2004 tsunami that devastated Thailand.

programme.title: Midway

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

programme.title: Blades of Glory

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Johnny Depp is Ichabod Crane, an investigator determined to stop the murderous Headless Horseman.

programme.title: Blood and Chocolate

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Shaolin Wooden Men [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his father, Little Mute trains in Shaolin Temple for revenge and is taught by various teachers, one of which is clandestine.

programme.title: To Kill With Intrigue
programme.desc: After the execution of his family by a gang, Lei Shao-feng is spared by its afflicting leader who stands in the way of him becoming reunited with his love, as does a traitorous friend, who takes advantage of their predicament.

programme.title: Snake & Crane Arts of Shaolin [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: A martial arts book, which Hsu Yin-Fung (Jackie Chan) carries, is being highly sought by various clans and gangs, but he is in pursuit of someone himself.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians threatens to move the team unless the team delivers immediate results. She then fills the roster with has-beens to guarantee their failure. But the team miraculously rallies and starts winning.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: What's Love Got to Do With It?
programme.desc: In London, an award-winning filmmaker documents her best friend's journey into an arranged marriage in line with his family's Pakistani heritage. In the process, she challenges her own attitude towards relationships.

programme.title: I Love You, Man
programme.desc: A friendless groom-to-be meets the ultimate dude and the two begin a "bro-mance" which takes male-bonding to hilarious new heights that will keep you laughing to the end.

programme.title: Baggage Claim
programme.desc: Montana Moore is determined to get engaged before her sister’s wedding in just 30 days!

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: Enough
programme.desc: An abused wife on the run from her violent husband finally decides she's had enough.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Varsity Blues
programme.desc: At first, backup quarterback Jonathan is no football star. But when the starting quarterback is injured, he is thrown into the game and also finds himself in direct conflict with his coach and girlfriend.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, and that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: Last Train From Gun Hill
programme.desc: Screen giants Kirk Douglas and Anthony Quinn star in this taut Western thriller directed by acclaimed filmmaker John Sturges (Gunfight at the O.K. Corral, The Great Escape).

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
programme.desc: The epic story of a mysterious stranger with a harmonica who joins forces with a notorious desperado to protect a beautiful widow from a ruthless assassin working for the railroad.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Britt Reid is a slacker by day, party animal by night... until he finds a serious career that's seriously cool: crime-fighting action hero. As the Green Hornet, he teams up with gadget wiz and martial arts master Kato to take down LA's underworld.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair faces an even greater threat lurking beneath the surface.

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: The Pope Of Greenwich Village
programme.desc: Daryl Hannah, Mickey Rourke and Eric Roberts star in this funny, high-voltage story of two small-time thieves after a big score in New York's Little Italy.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: When Jack Deebs was behind bars he found escape by creating Cool World, a cartoon series featuring a vixen named Holli Would. The flesh proves weaker than ink, however, as Holli takes human form in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing, and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: Urban Legends: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: On a prom night dare, a trio of high school friends chants an incantation, unleashing an evil spirit from the past with deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Possession of Hannah Grace

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: Mimic

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Gridiron Gang
programme.desc: Sean Porter (Johnson) is a frustrated probation officer, as most of the kids he oversees end up back in prison or dead. Desperate to make a difference, he devises a plan to teach discipline and responsibility through football.

programme.title: Wheels On Meals
programme.desc: Action-packed and full of fun, set off on a wacky adventure with kung-fu fighting cousins Thomas and David whose simple life running a fast-food van in Spain is turned upside down by the beautiful pickpocket Sylvia.

programme.title: The Protector
programme.desc: Two New York cops, Billy Wong and Danny Garoni, head to Hong Kong after the daughter of a rich businessman is kidnapped by the drug lord, Mr. Ko.

programme.title: Xia Ri Fu Xing aka Twinkle Twinkle Lucky Stars
programme.desc: The do-gooder Lucky Stars gang takes a well-deserved break in Thailand where they are told to contact an informant. Their vacation is cut short when the informant is murdered sending them back to Hong Kong to protect his girlfriend.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: Voted “one of the 10 funniest movies ever made” by the American Film Institute, “Airplane!” is a masterpiece of off-the-wall comedy.

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: There’s a mad bomber on board, the first lunar shuttle is about to self-destruct, the engines are not working, and worst of all, the flight crew discovers they are completely out of coffee!

programme.title: I Love You, Man
programme.desc: A friendless groom-to-be meets the ultimate dude and the two begin a "bro-mance" which takes male-bonding to hilarious new heights that will keep you laughing to the end.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: A mother falls for a younger man while her daughter falls in love for the first time. Mother Nature messes with their fates.

programme.title: John Tucker Must Die
programme.desc: Cheerleaders use a newcomer to exact revenge on their cheating boyfriend.

programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Identity
programme.desc: What if every choice we ever made was already made for us? What if there really were no coincidences in life and our destinies were already predetermined? Ten strangers with secrets are brought together in a savage rainstorm. Rated: R

programme.title: Son of a Gun
programme.desc: JR, a teenage criminal, is locked up for a minor crime and forced to adapt to the harsh realities of prison life. Brendan Lynch (Ewan McGregor), one of Australia's most notorious criminals, offers JR protection, but it comes with a price.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: The Soloist
programme.desc: A Los Angeles newspaper reporter discovers a brilliant and distracted street musician, with unsinkable passion, and a unique friendship and bond transforms both their lives.

programme.title: American Beauty
programme.desc: Lester's life is far from perfect. As he makes a few changes in his life, the freer and the happier he gets. However, Lester is about to learn that the ultimate freedom comes at a price.

programme.title: Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: This ambitious frontier epic features a lawman (Kris Kristofferson) and a hitman (Christopher Walken) who fight in a tragic class war between ranchers and starving immigrants.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Monster Trucks
programme.desc: When high school senior Tripp discovers a gas-guzzling creature named Creech, the unlikely duo team up for a fun-filled, hilarious and heartfelt adventure in a real-life super-powered Monster Truck to reunite Creech with his family.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair faces an even greater threat lurking beneath the surface.

programme.title: The Possession of Hannah Grace
programme.desc: Following a failed exorcism, Megan Reed (Shay Mitchell) is working overnight at the morgue when she takes delivery of a disfigured cadaver. Soon, Megan begins to experience horrifying visions and starts to suspect that a demon may possess her body.

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's The Corsican Brothers
programme.desc: A whacked-out Comedy about a pair of irreverent brothers who battle a dastardly baron.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: As the vampire Maximillian, the popular star is the most diabolical, dashing, and definitely undead dude in the ‘hood.

programme.title: Night of the Comet
programme.desc: A huge comet passes near the earth, vaporizing nearly the whole planet. But a few partially exposed people are now blood-thirsty zombies, and they begin a hunt for the remaining humans.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: "The Ruins" follows a group of friends who become entangled in a struggle for survival after visiting a remote archaeological dig in the Mexican jungle, where they discover something deadly living among the ruins.

programme.title: The Front Room
programme.desc: Everything goes to hell for newly-pregnant Belinda (Brandy) after her mother-in-law (Kathryn Hunter) moves in. As the diabolical guest tries to get her claws on the child, Belinda must draw the line somewhere…

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Armed and Dangerous (1986)
programme.desc: John Candy and Eugene Levy charge into the world of private security in the outrageous action-comedy ARMED AND DANGEROUS. Unfortunately, they're usually charging in the wrong direction! Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Planes, Trains & Automobiles
programme.desc: Neal just wants to fly home to Chicago for Thanksgiving with his family. But all he gets is misery. Misery named Del Griffith, a loud-mouthed salesman who leads Neal on a wild goose chase.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Fire In The Sky
programme.desc: In 1975, logger Travis Walton (D.B. Sweeney) and his co-workers discovered a hovering UFO. Walton's pals fled, but Walton was not so fortunate. Whisked aboard the strange craft, he was subjected to a painful, unearthly medical study.

programme.title: We Own the Night
programme.desc: What if your own family stood in the way of everything you worked for? Bobby Green (Joaquin Phoenix) has forsaken his name to escape his family and their tradition in law enforcement to pursue his ambitions as a Brooklyn nightclub owner. Rated R

programme.title: Road to Perdition
programme.desc: Bonds of loyalty are put to the test when a hitman's son witnesses what his father does for a living.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A man tries to transport an ancient gun called The Mexican, believed to carry a curse, back across the border, while his girlfriend pressures him to give up his criminal ways.

programme.title: Midsommar
programme.desc: An American couple, their relationship foundering, travel to a fabled Swedish midsummer festival where they become trapped in a sinister nightmare.

programme.title: MaXXXine
programme.desc: Aspiring movie star and hustler Maxine Minx (Mia Goth) finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of 1980s Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.

programme.title: Private Parts
programme.desc: Private Parts follows Howard Stern’s amazing transformation from school nerd to media superstar.

programme.title: Dick
programme.desc: The year is 1972, and Betsy Jobs and Arlene Lorenzo just want to have a good time. But during a class field trip to the White House, they cluelessly wander into a behind-closed-doors, top-secret shredding session. Rating: PG-13

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: The Boys From Brazil
programme.desc: A Nazi hunter in Paraguay discovers a sinister and bizarre plot to rekindle the Third Reich.

programme.title: The Molly Maguires
programme.desc: Life is rough in the coal mines of 1876 Pennsylvania. A group of Irish emigrant miners, known as the Molly Maguires, fights against the cruelty of the mining company with sabotage.

programme.title: Big Jake
programme.desc: An aging Texas cattle man who has outlived his time swings into action when outlaws kidnap his grandson and wound his son.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D., and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earth's closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety, but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 4
programme.desc: Katie disappeared with her nephew, Hunter, and there were no survivors. Five years later, she's returned with a mysterious boy, ready to target new victims with her demonic rage in a quiet neighborhood.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: For the first time, you will SEE the activity... When a new family moves into a familiar house, they discover a mysterious video camera that reveals a demonic threat and soon find themselves terrorized by an ancient evil.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones
programme.desc: The activity is back and has claimed a new victim. Jesse has been hearing horrifying sounds from his neighbor’s apartment, but when he sets out to uncover their source, he encounters an ancient evil that won’t rest until it’s claimed his soul.

programme.title: The Impossible
programme.desc: A couple and their three sons encounter terror, courage and compassion following the December 2004 tsunami that devastated Thailand.

programme.title: Midway
programme.desc: On June 4, 1942, the Japanese navy plans a strike against American ships in the Pacific. For the next three days, the U.S. Navy and a squad of brave fighter pilots engage the enemy in one of the most important and decisive battles of World War II.

programme.title: American Psycho
programme.desc: A mentally unhinged yuppie in the 1980s New York submits to an uncontrollable bloodlust.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Enter the world of 1970s TV news, where Ron Burgundy and his loyal Channel 4 News Team are San Diego's #1 rated news source. All is well in their male-dominated world of news until rising star reporter Veronica Corningstone turns it upside down.

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: The Players Club
programme.desc: A single mom tries to work her way through college, moonlighting as an exotic dancer.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: 1930's New York. The black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. If the seeds of Harlem's urban power would not grow in the White city, the Black underground would form to take control.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

programme.title: Rocky IV
programme.desc: East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5

programme.title: Semplicemente irresistibile

programme.desc: Un prezioso carico destinato ai sudisti viene preso di mira dai ladri. I loro tentativi di rubarlo, però, sono sventati dagli attenti custodi. Fatica sprecata, in quanto il viaggio era solo una manovra diversiva: l'oro è già al sicuro.

programme.title: Più forte sorelle
programme.desc: Nel Far West un gruppo di suore assolda Amen, un cacciatore di taglie, per fargli recuperare alcuni soldi che erano stati rubati dal monastero. Amen dovrà vedersela con il temibile Catapult per aiutare le sorelle in difficoltà.

programme.title: Alleluja e Sartana figli di... Dio
programme.desc: Alleluja e Sartana rubano alcuni cavalli di proprietà di un delinquente soprannominato Lupo. I suoi uomini li inseguono, il secondo viene catturato ma il primo riesce a salvarlo.

programme.title: Che botte ragazzi!
programme.desc: Un losco boss della città, Pat Barnes, ha sfruttato quasi tutti gli abitanti della città. Chi non cede alle sue richieste di solito finisce per morire. Barnes viene finalmente sconfitto da Shanghai Joe.

programme.title: AE Apocalypse Earth
programme.desc: Un gruppo di rifugiati dalla Terra atterra su un pianeta esotico, dove deve combattere contro alieni spietati per poter sopravvivere.

programme.title: Meteor Moon
programme.desc: Quando una meteora si schianta sulla luna e ne sposta l'asse, la gravità terrestre trascina la luna sulla traiettoria del pianeta. Ora, un gruppo di scienziati deve capire come impedire alla luna di colpire la Terra prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: Avengers Grimm: Time Wars
programme.desc: Il sovrano degli Inferi, Tremotino, si nasconde, escogitando dei piani per conquistare la Terra una volta per tutte. Mentre gli Avengers Grimm combattono per fermarlo, scoprono rapidamente che non è dove si nasconde Tremotino, ma quando.

programme.title: Renegade: Cercasi disperatamente Molly
programme.desc: Una bambina di nome Molly va da Sandy dicendo che è stata rapita e mostra una confezione di latte con la sua foto e la scritta "scomparsa"; si scopre che Molly vive coi suoi genitori, suo padre è un testimone protetto e deve continuamente trasferirsi.

programme.title: Renegade: Casinò
programme.desc: Una banda di motociclisti deruba i vincitori di un casinò, il padrone del locale chiama Bobby in aiuto e lo assume in incognito. Intanto, Reno trova la banda in un paese vicino ma il capo lo riconosce e lo obbliga a partecipare al furto successivo.

programme.title: Renegade: Spie
programme.desc: Melissa, la moglie di Dixon, è intenzionata a far condannare il marito e chiede aiuto a Reno e Bobby. Reno accetta: la donna difatti non finge, è rimasta disgustata dal fatto che Dixon è ora complice di un giro di pornografia minorile.

programme.title: Renegade: Nuova identità
programme.desc: Imbattendosi in un uomo creduto morto, Bobby scopre che una banda offre la possibilità ai ricercati di fingere la propria morte. Intanto, Bobby viene raggiunto da una collega di cui si innamora.

programme.title: Renegade: Il dinamitardo
programme.desc: Un rapinatore ha colpito varie banche fingendo di avere, un maldestro informatore di Bobby cerca di arrestarlo, finendo lui stesso catturato dal ladro. L'uomo convince il rapinatore che Bobby pagherà una grossa somma per riaverlo vivo.

programme.title: Renegade: Il vero padre
programme.desc: Janet, che era stata fidanzata di Reno anni prima, è perseguitata da suo marito che l'ha ritrovata dopo che lei si era trasferita per sfuggirgli; Reno inizia quindi a proteggerla.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Chimera
programme.desc: C'è un nanite organico senziente che sta causando il caos nel sistema informatico del Santuario. Magnus e Tesla collegano le loro menti al sistema nel tentativo di isolare il nanite. Trovano invece Adam Worth

programme.title: Sanctuary: Gli Accolti
programme.desc: Un gruppo radicale di esseri anormali pianifica un attacco terroristico con l'obiettivo di iniziare una guerra tra gli abitanti della superficie e gli abitanti della Terra Cava. Addison, all'NSA, ha le prove che Biggie è a capo del gruppo.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Gli Abissi
programme.desc: Quando Magnus e Will vengono a conoscenza di un piano per catturare degli Anormali molto rari e pericolosi, si recano in una grotta remota per impedire poi la caccia.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Un Rifugio Per Nessuno Prima Parte
programme.desc: Quando il Santuario è avvicinato da un leader degli anormali per un piano radicale per la pace, Magnus si impegna a dare il suo supporto. Tuttavia, quando Will è costretto a lasciare il Santuario, la sua decisione potrebbe mettere tutti in pericolo.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Un Rifugio Per Nessuno Seconda Parte
programme.desc: La SCIU ha circondato il Quinto Reparto con truppe e uno scudo elettrico che impedisce loro di uscire. Caleb ha un virus che può trasformare la popolazione umana in anormali. Magnus mette in atto il suo piano finale per la rete dei Santuari.

programme.title: Sanctuary: Un Rifugio Per Tutti Prima Parte
programme.desc: La dottoressa Helen Magnus recluta un perspicace psichiatra forense chiamato Will Zimmerman per unirsi a lei nella ricerca di rintracciare, studiare e proteggere le strane e spesso terrificanti creature che popolano segretamente il nostro mondo.

programme.title: Un killer nascosto in casa
programme.desc: Ispirata a una storia vera - Una madre protegge la figliastra dopo che l'adolescente ha assistito all'omicidio della sua migliore amica, ma è presto costretta a fare i conti con il vero assassino!

programme.title: Fuga dal passato
programme.desc: Amelia e il suo blog sono un punto di riferimento per tutte le donne maltrattate dai loro compagni. Nel momento in cui sembra essersi rimessa in piedi e aver trovato nuova serenità, la ragazza comincia però a ricevere strane minacce.

programme.title: Il mistero dell'isola
programme.desc: Durante una vacanza da sogno con suo marito, una donna diventa un bersaglio dopo aver iniziato a sospettare che uno degli abitanti dell'isola possa aver commesso più omicidi.

programme.title: La banda degli onesti
programme.desc: Tre uomini perbene ma goffi che affrontano difficoltà economiche iniziano con riluttanza a fabbricare banconote false. Il figlio di uno di loro è il poliziotto che segue il caso, ignorando il coinvolgimento del padre.

programme.title: I due orfanelli
programme.desc: Gaspare e Battista vivono in un collegio di Parigi che accoglie i "figli di nessuno". Quando Il primo scopre di essere il discendente di una nobile e ricca famiglia, parte per cercare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Le motorizzate
programme.desc: Negli episodi del film si susseguono una suora dalla guida spericolata; una mondana che vive su una roulotte; uno sportivo che rifiuta il passaggio offertogli da una bella motorizzata..

programme.title: Uccellacci E Uccellini
programme.desc: Totò e Ninetto, vagabondano nella periferia romana per minacciare di sfratto una famiglia che non paga l'affitto. Nel tragitto li segue un corvo parlante, intellettuale e marxista, che racconta le vicende dei frati francescani Ciccillo e Ninetto.

programme.title: Gli Immortali – Seagal vs Lundgren
programme.desc: Gli Immortali è il canale dedicato ai giganti del cinema d'azione: un vero e proprio campo di battaglia dove le più grandi star del genere si scontrano attraverso i loro film più iconici.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Lo sciame
programme.desc: Navigando all'interno dello spazio di una specie aliena ostile, la Voyager viene attaccata da uno sciame di piccole navicelle aliene. Inoltre la memoria del Dottore è sovraccarica, rendendo necessario ricorrere al programma diagnostico olografico.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Profeti e perdite
programme.desc: La Voyager rileva le tracce di replicatori del quadrante Alfa; seguendo le tracce, arriva a un pianeta governato da due ferengi, adorati dalla popolazione come semidei. Nel sistema stellare è anche presente un tunnel spaziale instabile.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Un sogno per ricordare
programme.desc: La Voyager accoglie a bordo dei passeggeri da Enara Prime, che si rivelano appartenere ad una specie telepate. B'Elanna Torres comincia a fare sogni molto intensi, riguardanti una relazione proibita tra una donna e un membro dei Reazionari.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Terra sacra
programme.desc: Durante una visita al pianeta dei Nechani, Kes entra in un tempio sacro e cade misteriosamente in coma. Janeway è quindi costretta a rivolgersi al consiglio sacro del pianeta per sapere come sia possibile curarla.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Futuro anteriore - Prima parte
programme.desc: La Voyager incontra una distorsione spaziale, dalla quale esce una navetta il cui occupante, il capitano Braxton, riferisce che nel XXIX secolo, dal quale proviene, la Voyager ha causato la distruzione della Terra, e quindi deve distruggerla.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Futuro anteriore - Seconda parte
programme.desc: Starling riesce ad attivare la nave temporale e progetta di ottenere tecnologie da altri secoli. La Voyager cerca di distruggere la nave prima che Starling riesca ad attivarla.

programme.title: Duri a Morire

programme.title: Racconti d'estate
programme.desc: Su una spiaggia della Riviera, durante l’estate, si intrecciano amori fugaci e illusioni: passioni interessate, tradimenti, sogni di riscatto e delusioni sentimentali. Un affresco corale tra desideri, inganni e malinconie della stagione più calda.

programme.title: L'arte di arrangiarsi
programme.desc: Rosario Scimoni ha vent'anni e vive a Catania all'inizio del XX secolo. Ama due cose nella vita: le donne e il denaro ed è il segretario del sindaco che è suo zio e l'amante della moglie del sindaco.

programme.title: Arrivano i dollari!
programme.desc: 5 fratelli scoprono che uno zio ha lasciato loro in eredità una grossa somma. Ma solo liberandosi dei loro difetti potranno entrarne in possesso. Tutti cercano allora di mettersi in buona luce con la bellissima moglie dello zio cercando di ingannarla.

programme.title: Il vedovo
programme.desc: Un romano trapiantato a Milano, che s'è sposato solo per interesse, crede che la ricchissima moglie sia morta in un incidente e pensa già a come adoperare i suoi milioni. La donna, invece, è viva. Il poveraccio prepara allora un piano per farla fuori.

programme.title: Man from earth
programme.desc: Il party a sorpresa per il pensionamento del professor John Oldman si trasforma in un mistero quando l'uomo rivela ai suoi colleghi di essere in realtà un immortale che erra sulla terra da ormai 14 mila anni.

programme.title: Alien Abduction - Rapimenti Alieni
programme.desc: La famiglia Morris si trova in vacanza sulle Brown Mountain in North Carolina per vivere un’esperienza a stretto contatto con la natura.

programme.title: 2021 War of the Worlds
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, il mondo viene invaso da una flotta di navi aliene, intenzionate a liberare il pianeta dalla sua popolazione con ogni mezzo.

programme.title: Il fiume delle verità
programme.desc: Un giovane abbandona la famiglia per una vita solitaria di pesca a mosca. Il suo obiettivo era trovare la propria strada nel mondo della pesca e quindi ritrovare se stesso e l'amore.

programme.title: Una Vacanza Del Cactus
programme.desc: Un danaroso e voglioso commendatore, un amico fesso, una bella segretaria e una moglie miope e impicciona, sono gli ingredienti di questa commedia sexy all'italiana con i mitici Anna Maria Rizzoli, Enzo Cannavale e Bombolo.

programme.title: Tutta colpa di Sara
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata notificata della richiesta di divorzio, una donna convince un ufficiale giudiziario ad aiutarla a riottenere ciò che le è dovuto.

programme.title: Sorority Secrets
programme.desc: Cassie vuole far parte di un gruppo esclusivo della sua scuola, ma viene sempre superata da altre compagne. Quando le ragazze iniziano a essere assassinate, Cassie indaga e scopre che la confraternita fa parte di un giro di prostituzione.

programme.title: Il segreto della mia famiglia
programme.desc: Rachel Collins si prepara per il suo sedicesimo compleanno, ma durante la festa si trova davanti a un tragico omicidio. L'evento svela un'oscura rete di bugie nella sua famiglia e Rachel mette in discussione tutto quello che ha sempre saputo.

programme.title: L'incubo di Sophie
programme.desc: Una studentessa del liceo che rimane vittima di un falso pettegolezzo, diffuso dalla compagna Carolyne. La madre di Sophie deve trovare il modo di porre fine alla situazione prima che diventi mortale.

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: Il Lyceum Theatre di Crewe è noto per la sua attività paranormale e in questo episodio il team affronta i fantasmi che si nascondono nel buio con conseguenze spaventose.

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: Il fantasma di un soldato annegato attende Yvette e la sua squadra di esperti paranormali, mentre affrontano le infestazioni che affliggono questo magnifico castello.

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: Immersa nella campagna britannica, la casa di Halsham nasconde un poltergeist che attende la squadra. Con le ossa ritrovate in soffitta, la squadra si spinge oltre.

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: Yvette porta la sua squadra impavida in una casa di cura per indagare sugli strani avvenimenti segnalati dal personale e dagli ospiti. Non ci vuole molto perché Yvette rimpianga la sua decisione.

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: La squadra di Most Haunted visita una dimora nella campagna del Cheshire, dove una voce senza corpo diffonde terrore e paura.

programme.title: Milano rovente
programme.desc: Salvatore Cangemi, proprietario di una società di ortofrutta di giorno e magnaccia di notte, viene minacciato da uno spietato gangster francese chiamato Le Capitaine che vuole unire il crimine organizzato a Milano per ottenere tutti i profitti.

programme.title: Ai margini della metropoli
programme.desc: Diretto da Carlo Lizzani e ispirato all'omicidio di Annarella Bracci. Un giovane viene arrestato per un delitto non commesso poiché tutti gli indizi gli sono contro. Lo aiutano un avvocato di pochi scrupoli e un'amica dalla quale si è rifugiato.

programme.title: Napoli Serenata Calibro 9
programme.desc: Durante una rapina, quattro balordi uccidono una donna ed un bambino: sono la moglie e il figlio di Don Salvatore Savastano, temuto contrabbandiere che da quel momento si trasforma in un giustiziere solitario senza altro altro scopo che la vendetta.

programme.title: Mutant X: Sotto un manto di guerra
programme.desc: Shalimar viene mandata sotto copertura in un mortale giro di assassinii ad alta tecnologia, per scoprire perché vogliono Adam morto.

programme.title: Mutant X: Una volta intorno
programme.desc: La squadra interviene per proteggere un testimone principale dell'accusa la cui vita è stata minacciata prima del processo.

programme.title: Mutant X: Il giudizio finale
programme.desc: Un misterioso tribunale dichiara Adam colpevole di aver cercato di dominare il mondo con i suoi super-mutanti e lo condanna a morte, spingendo il resto della squadra in missione per salvarlo.

programme.title: Mutant X: L'inferno
programme.desc: La squadra è sulle tracce di un mutante piromane che sta causando il caos, mentre Shalimar è costretta a mettere da parte la sua paura del fuoco per salvare Emma.

programme.title: Mutant X: Un passo più vicino
programme.desc: La squadra lotta per contenere i poteri mutanti fuori controllo di Brennan quando mette in pericolo la missione per proteggere la figlia di un senatore.

programme.title: Le Ragazze Di Campagna
programme.desc: Tre giovani donne provenienti da percorsi di vita molto diversi si uniscono all'esercito di terra femminile durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale e vengono inviate a lavorare insieme in una fattoria nel Dorset. L'esperienza cambierà per sempre le loro vite.

programme.title: Berlino: Opzione Zero
programme.desc: Berlino, 1978. Un sostituto procuratore americano, Herbert J. Stern, viene chiamato a giudicare sulla legittimità dell'operato di un tedesco che, con la complicità di una donna, ha dirottato un aereo da Berlino Est a Berlino Ovest.

programme.title: Altamira
programme.desc: Nel 1879 Maria e suo padre archeologo scoprono in una caverna antichi dipinti preistorici. La madre, appoggiata dalla Chiesa, li vede come un attacco alla Bibbia. Maria resta divisa tra due mondi, senza modelli di riferimento, alla ricerca della verità

programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: Un triangolo amoroso sullo sfondo del conflitto armeno

programme.title: My Kitchen Rules Australia

programme.title: My Kitchen Rules Australia

programme.title: My Kitchen Rules Australia

programme.title: True Jackson: Pilot
programme.desc: True Jackson, quindici anni, viene assunta dal designer Max Madigan che la nota mentre vende panini scaduti all'interno del distretto della moda e la nomina Vice Presidente della linea giovanile.

programme.title: True Jackson: True Conquista L'islanda
programme.desc: Sta per arrivare il proprietario della più grande catena di negozi di abbigliamento d'Islanda e Max chiede ad Amanda e True di creare un modello in grado di accaparrarsi il cliente.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Licenziamento Di Lulu
programme.desc: Lulu, la migliore amica di True, nel ruolo di assistente, ne combina di tutti i colori mettendo a repentaglio la sua e la reputazione di True, al punto che Max le ordina di licenziarla.

programme.title: True Jackson: Una Baby Sitter Per Dakota
programme.desc: La top model quindicenne Dakota North viene scelta come testimonial della linea di moda autunnale della Mad Style e True viene incaricata di farle compagnia.

programme.title: True Jackson: Chi Lo Dice Ad Amanda?
programme.desc: Ryan scopre che il fidanzato di Amanda, Chad, a pranzo ha appuntamento con un'altra. Decide di seguirlo insieme a True.

programme.title: True Jackson: L'organizzatrice Di Incontri
programme.desc: True consegna un misterioso pacco, proveniente da Parigi, al signor Madigan. La consegna del pacco rende il signor Madigan molto triste.

programme.title: True Jackson: Ritorno Al Liceo
programme.desc: Amanda viene invitata a una festa dei vecchi compagni di liceo e pensa di approfittarne per saldare un vecchio conto rimasto in sospeso con la ex compagna Emily.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Prototipo
programme.desc: Lulu è stata invitata ad un ballo all'Accademia delle Belle Arti, e chiede a True se può disegnarle un abito per quell'evento.

programme.title: iCarly: Il sabotaggio
programme.desc: I Plain White T's devono suonare ad iCarly, ma Nevel progetta di sabotare l'evento facendo hackeraggio sul sito.

programme.title: iCarly: La punizione
programme.desc: Sam viene punita dal professor Horward, il più tremendo di tutto l'istituto, ed è costretta a tornare la sera a scuola, proprio il giorno in cui deve andare in onda la 50esima puntata di ICarly.

programme.title: iCarly: Uno sponsor per iCarly
programme.desc: Un'azienda produttrice di scarpe chiede a Carly, Sam e Freddie di lanciare nella loro trasmissione web un nuovo modello di scarpe da tennis, molto trendy e tecnologiche.

programme.title: iCarly: La promessa
programme.desc: Carly ottiene una B nel compito di storia e si intristisce perchè pensa di meritare di più. Sam penetra nel computer della scuola per modificare il voto e così va tutto a posto, finchè Carly si trova a dover fare i conti con la propria coscienza.

programme.title: iCarly: Va in TV
programme.desc: Visto il successo che iCarly riscuote sul web, il funzionario di un'emittente televisiva contatta i ragazzi e propone loro di trasferire gli episodi in televisione.

programme.title: iCarly: L'odioso ragazzo di Sam
programme.desc: Quando la nuova relazione di Sam inizia a influire negativamente sullo show, Carly e Freddie fanno di tutto per far sì che Sam e il suo nuovo fidanzato si lascino.

programme.title: iCarly: L'appostamento
programme.desc: La polizia di Seattle è sulle tracce di un venditore di DVD pirata che compare per caso in una delle trasmissioni di iCarly. Due poliziotti organizzano un appostamento nell'appartamento di Carly.

programme.title: iCarly: Scuola nuova, amici nuovi
programme.desc: Carly riceve un invito per un colloquio con la preside della Briarwood, una scuola costosa e rinomata.

programme.title: iCarly: Scherma e schermaglie
programme.desc: Nonostante Freddie si diverta a passare il tempo libero con Carly e Sam a realizzare il web-show, sente l'esigenza di stare anche con dei ragazzi e fare cose da "maschi".

programme.title: iCarly: Vinci un incontro galante
programme.desc: Gibby è segretamente innamorato di Shannon, ma sa che non riuscirà mai a conquistarla, perché a lei piace Freddie.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Allenamento al Giardino Imperiale!
programme.desc: È notte e Arion ripensa al suo allenatore Mark che si è sacrificato per salvare lui e la sua squadra. La mattina successiva, assieme a Fey e ai rimanenti membri della Raimon, apprende dalla professoressa Hills.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: L’Armatura dello Spirito Guerriero
programme.desc: JP, Arion, Ryoma, Riccardo e Victor si stanno scontrando contro la divisione a5, la squadra formata dai 5 giocatori della Protocollo Omega che vogliono vendicare Alpha.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Gli Insegnamenti del Maestro
programme.desc: I giocatori della Raimon junior high (Victor, Arion, Ryoma, Riccardo e JP) viaggiano nel futuro per introdursi all'interno di un museo commemorativo del calcio che fra duecento anni custodirà un libro, “gli insegnamenti del maestro”.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone
programme.desc: Arion e gli altri sono a casa di zia silvia e cercano di decifrare i misteriosi quaderni che – secondo le loro informazioni – contengono le istruzioni per creare la squadra invincibile.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Alla Ricerca della Squadra Invincibile
programme.desc: Ricomincia la partita contro la Protocollo Omega 2.0 e il maestro decide di aiutare la Raimon dichiarando che la chiave per la vittoria è in 3d. I ragazzi all’inizio non capiscono e pensano che si riferisca a qualcosa che inizia con la lettera d.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Il Villaggio di Nobunaga
programme.desc: I nostri protagonisti si trovano nel 1554, all'epoca di Nobunaga oda. Il loro obiettivo è cercare di impossessarsi dell'aura di Nobunaga per costituire la squadra più forte di tutti i tempi.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Contro la Banda dei Cervi Bianchi!
programme.desc: Comincia la sfida tra la Raimon e la banda dei cervi bianchi, ipnotizzati e comandati da beta. Tasuke e i suoi quattro amici si uniscono alla Raimon per ovviare alla carenza di giocatori, ma i ragazzi non hanno idea di come si giochi a calcio.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Operazione Danza
programme.desc: Il gruppo di Arion si trova nel Giappone feudale, con l'obiettivo di catturare l'aura del signore del luogo, tale Nobunaga, e trasferirla a Riccardo. Mentre quest'ultimo si allena per riuscire ad accogliere e trattenere l'aura di Nobunaga.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Allenamento nell'Owari
programme.desc: Arion e gli altri si trovano di fronte a Nobunaga e viene chiesto loro di discolparsi dall'accusa di voler attentare alla sua vita, magari per conto del rivale Imagawa.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Duello Durante la Festa
programme.desc: I ragazzi della Raimon insieme a Tasuke e gli altri, sotto il nome di oda, si scontrano contro la Protocollo Omega, che prende il nome di Imagawa. La Imagawa si dimostra subito molto forte e Tasuke e gli altri iniziano a spaventarsi.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven Go Chrono Stone: Il Sogno di Governare
programme.desc: I protagonisti stanno giocando una partita contro la squadra di Imagawa, che conduce il gioco per un punteggio di 2 a 1.

programme.title: CBS Morning News

programme.title: CBS Mornings

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: La battaglia per la Dimensione X
programme.desc: La battaglia per la Dimensione X' - Le Tartarughe devono guadagnare la fiducia del Consiglio degli Utrom per poter trovare gli ultimi 2 frammenti del generatore di buchi neri.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: L'oceano cosmico
programme.desc: L'oceano cosmico' - Le Tartarughe fanno rotta verso l'oceano cosmico di Varuna, dove è custodito il secondo frammento del generatore di buchi neri.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tartarughe transdimensionali
programme.desc: Tartarughe transdimensionali' - Le Tartarughe Ninja vengono teletrasportate in un'altra dimensione e incontrano le loro controparti del 1987.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: La vendetta dei Triceraton
programme.desc: La vendetta dei Triceraton' - I Triceraton attaccano la navicella di Fugitoid. Riescono ad impossessarsi dei due frammenti del generatore di buchi neri.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: La malvagità di Dregg
programme.desc: La malvagità di Dregg' - All'Ulisse arriva un segnale di richiesta di aiuto da parte di Monna Lisa, la salamandriana di cui Raffaello è innamorato.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Il fuoco eterno
programme.desc: Il fuoco eterno' - La squadra composta dalle Tartarughe, April, Casey e Fugitoid deve superare ostacoli quasi impossibili: I Triceraton, Lord Dregg e la belva del cosmo Tokka.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Ultimo baluardo: la Terra
programme.desc: Ultimo baluardo: la Terra' - Quando la squadra sta per raggiungere la terra, Fugitoid rivela una terribile verità che finora aveva tenuto nascosta.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Città in guerra
